agent_notes: The official identity, website and Prayagraj campus match the supplied institution context.

The catalogue is marked partial because the central PG page is last updated 26 April 2020 and says it is valid for 2020-21, while current 2026 admission and department pages expose additional or differently named programmes.

The institutional About Us page says nine B.Tech programmes and nineteen M.Tech programmes, but current department pages expose additional programme names including Engineering and Computational Mechanics, Materials Engineering, Mathematics and Computing, and newer M.Tech programmes; this count conflict requires manual review.
The current Physics page describes M.Sc. in Physics as approved and expected to admit from 2024-25, but does not provide a current admission-cycle confirmation.
The About Us page mentions Master of Social work (M.S.W.) but no current dedicated course catalogue page was found, so it is retained as a verified programme family with manual-review status.

The School of Management Studies page lists Executive MBA, while the current admission page separately lists M.B.A. (Part-Time); both are retained and the naming/status relationship requires manual review.

No standalone diploma or certificate programme was clearly identified in the official catalogue. Short-term courses, workshops, first-year subjects, minors, admission modes, and explicitly old/archive curricula were excluded.
Duration and eligibility were left null unless explicitly stated on an official page.
The managed proxy returned the exact self signed certificate in certificate chain error. Public GETs used curl --insecure only after confirming the expected search and mnnit.ac.in hostnames.

Career mappings were checked read-only against assets/data/career_path.db. Generic, interdisciplinary, postgraduate and doctoral programmes use nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings where the career tree has no exact programme node.
